overall_goal: Season the chickpeas with oil and spices and roast them in the oven

goals.description: Transfer the chickpeas onto a baking tray
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a baking tray and pours the chickpeas onto it, picking up any loose pieces and skins.

goals.description: Measure and drizzle olive oil over the chickpeas
goals.rationale: The person finds the correct measuring spoon, measures out olive oil, pours it over the chickpeas, and shakes the tray to coat them.

goals.description: Select and gather the required spice jars
goals.rationale: The person searches through the drawer, reading labels to select the necessary spices, and places them on the counter.

goals.description: Measure and sprinkle the first two spices over the chickpeas
goals.rationale: The person opens the first two spice jars, measures out the spices, and sprinkles them evenly over the chickpeas.

goals.description: Measure and sprinkle the remaining spices over the chickpeas
goals.rationale: The person continues to open the remaining spice jars, measuring and distributing the spices onto the baking tray.

goals.description: Stir the seasoned chickpeas and put the tray in the oven
goals.rationale: The person stirs the chickpeas to ensure they are evenly coated with oil and spices, then places the tray into the oven to roast.
